record.summary: All 48 target-free calls and bindings passed before the sole target read, but neither direct-D1 cap transfers. Baseline mean MSE is 3.026499284e-8; cap768 is 3.058098629e-8 (+1.0441%, 3/16 wins, paired t=-2.851) and cap512 is 3.072255205e-8 (+1.5118%, 3/16 wins, paired t=-3.326). Every literal candidate bill is still lower.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for direct cap768/cap512 on banked D1 because both fail the frozen mean-MSE and >=10/16 network-win conjunction. No selected-cap integration, conditional tail blend, package, or submission is licensed.
